page_title: MNU 3-2 BUR | Manchester Utd v Burnley 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' The free kick from long range, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+7' Kyle Walker (Burnley) attempts to discuss the decision with Samuel Barrott, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+7' Josh Laurent (Burnley) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+7' 3 - 2 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Martin Dubravka into the bottom left corner.
90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+6' The main referee, Samuel Barrott, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Lyle Foster (Burnley) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' The foul by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Samuel Barrott.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+3' Referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Manchester Utd. Let’s see what happens!
90+2' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) gets a yellow card. The referee Samuel Barrott made the right call.
87' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
86' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leny Yoro trots off the pitch and is replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
84' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
83' Here is a change. Hjalmar Ekdal is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Joe Worrall (Burnley).
83' Substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen walks off the pitch and Oliver Sonne (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
82' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
80' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.
79' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
76' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Josh Laurent (Burnley) replaces Lesley Ugochukwu.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) is replacing Casemiro.
71' Josh Cullen (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but Altay Bayindir comes off his line to gather the ball.
70' Josh Cullen (Burnley) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
66' 2 - 2 Goal! Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
66' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Altay Bayindir was alert and made an amazing save!
65' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) on for Hannibal Mejbri.

64' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post.
63' Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
63' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
59' A goal, which was scored by Lyle Foster (Burnley), was disallowed due to offside.
57' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Diogo Dalot laid the ball off to Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
55' 1 - 1 Lyle Foster (Burnley) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
53' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
48' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is flagged for offside.
48' The defensive wall jumps as one to block the free kick from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
46' Ruben Amorim makes a half-time substitution. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) comes on in place of Mason Mount.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' Samuel Barrott has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' CHANCE! Bryan Mbeumo finds Amad Diallo (Manchester United) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
45+4' A pass into space is latched onto by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United), and he bends a shot just wide of the right post that had the keeper worried.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.

45' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him to unleash a shot towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a great save to deny him.
45' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the corner.
44' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
43' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
40' OFF THE BAR! Mason Mount (Manchester United) outjumps the defence to connect with the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but his effort only crashes against the crossbar.
40' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
39' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
37' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just over the bar.
35' Kyle Walker (Burnley) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch for Matheus Cunha.
28' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) picks up an injury.
27' 1 - 0 Josh Cullen (Burnley) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!

27' Casemiro (Manchester United) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the bar and it glanced away off it.
26' Kyle Walker (Burnley) brings an opponent down and Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. Manchester Utd get a free kick.
23' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Leny Yoro (Manchester United), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
22' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' NO PENALTY! Referee Samuel Barrott has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Manchester Utd players are incensed.
18' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Manchester Utd, he's going to review using VAR.

17' Kyle Walker (Burnley) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! Manchester Utd have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
16' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the left post.
15' The goalkeeper dives to deny Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
13' Neat passing move from Manchester Utd in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

5' Martin Dubravka makes a good save! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
3' Mason Mount (Manchester United) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Manchester Utd will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
